title: Coordinate independence of the discrete derivative
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)$, and let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. The discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$, given at $x$ by half the difference between the values of $f$ with coordinate $i$ set to $1$ and to $-1$, depends only on coordinates $j\ne i$.
